page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes at left (side="left") beside the lines "p. 31." and "Thess. 2. 14.". Page number and running head at top. A line "ista" at the far right below the text is part of the text.

main_text.p: decernit, quæ erant in illis definita, ut ver-bi gratia capitibus primo, secundo, tertio, quinto, sexto, &c. quibus eadem definit, quæ jam erant in Apostolicis canonibus, primo, sexagesimo primo, tricesimo quarto, tricesimo sexto, duodecimo, &c. si Turriano quidem credimus definita? Ratio in promptu est; Nimirum canones Nicænos, quos citaret, cognitos habuit Innocentius; Apostolicos, quos laudaret, nullos plane norat; quos, siquos, novisset, non minus, quam Nicænos, nominatim laudaturus erat. Sed Turrianus tamen a p. 31.contra calcitrat a; & præter manifestam rerum rationem contendit, Innocentium hæc, quæ in illa epistola decernit, ex sua Apostolicorum canonum Sylloge desumpsisse. Quod ut probet, hæc recitat, quæ præfatur Innocentius; Non quo nova præcepta aliqua imperentur, sed ea quæ per desidiam aliquorum neglecta sunt, ab omnibus observari cupiamus; quæ tamen Apostolica, & Patrum traditione sunt constituta. Scriptum est enim namque ad Thessalonicenses, b Thess. 2. 14.Paulo monente b, State ac tenete traditiones nostras, quas tradidi vobis, sive per verbum, sive per epistolam. Hactenus Innocentius; ex quibus, quod primo colligit Turrianus, ego id equidem libens concedo, putasse ninimirum Innocentium, ista

page.notes: Marginal notes: "a p. 31." and "b Thess. 2. 14." at left, placed beside the lines where the reference marks a and b stand in the text. Printed "ista" at lower right is a catchword-like word after the last full line and is kept as the final word of the text. Reference marks in the text are not braced because they are printed as plain letters.
